scope: Full current prepare-panelist PowerShell test source and all in-file helpers/control oracles. No production-code coverage inferred from this test receipt.
method: Read source in complete sequential ranges and follow fixture/native/serialization/oracle/cleanup contracts; exact current bytes pinned.

boundaries: Complete 3062-line current source read, including all helper bodies, PP001-013, TEST013-017/032-077 and terminal literal-path/consent controls. This is a new complete source receipt, independent of the previously disconnected delta hash.

Invoke-Prepare launches the real prepare-panelist-input.ps1 with ProcessStartInfo.ArgumentList, preserving every path and option atom; stdout/stderr are drained asynchronously, native ExitCode captured, exceptional launch failure assigned99, and Process disposed in finally. No dynamic command source or provider/model service is invoked.

Fixture ownership starts at one random temporary root and ends in outer finally recursive cleanup; Git init/add/commit stays inside disposable scratch repositories. Commit failures throw; autocrlf=false pins worktree/blob bytes for historical hash controls. Fixed test paths are fixture inputs, not product exceptions.

Consent fixtures independently construct Markdown flags and real HMAC-SHA256 payloads from public test keys. PP001 overrides ambient key/skip-signature state and restores it; signature tests cover positive, tampered field, malformed nonce, expired/overlong token and wrong repository. Terminal controls require exact case for consent/repository identity. Skip-signature-only PP007 is explicitly identified and is not cryptographic proof.

Literal secret examples, URLs and paths are inert here-string content. Sanitization assertions search both forbidden sample fragments and preserved normal content. The suite neither fetches URLs nor logs live credentials; fixture diagnostic output contains only synthetic test values.

Write-PpiContract uses ConvertTo-Json with explicit array materialization; Markdown reports intentionally render fixture grammar, including bad row and annotation shapes. Test values reach the real parser as files. Regex assertions are fixed or escape dynamic sentinel/path literals; output content checks use Contains when exact literal text is intended.

Completeness/path controls pair existing matching outputs with missing/hash-mismatched counterparts; failure checks cover exits, missing digest and unpublished bundle. Traversal and symlink cases use sentinel absence and no bundle, including history that otherwise hash-matches. Symlink creation capability skips are printed explicitly.

Historical-declaration tests independently create v1/v2/delete/untracked report histories and use Get-FileHash over fixture bytes. Positive acceptance is separated from content assertions: current v2 bytes and stale notices required, historical/deleted sentinel bytes forbidden. Positive undrifted controls ensure warnings are conditional.

Task composition assertions distinguish own evidence from sibling task/panel output, require each spec marker, and check contract evidence/red/green paths plus dedup counts. Empty optional fields remain valid; missing contract evidence must be named and explained. TEST061 intentionally asserts stable explanatory prefix; exact base wording belongs to the separate WFI059 test.

Budget/elision controls construct deterministic500/20-line fixtures, independently compute UTF8 head/tail byte counts and assert first/last/middle markers and occurrence counts. Generous caps retain whole content; tight caps exercise largest-first selection, first-tier-before-second-tier ordering and unchanged no-publication when both tiers are exhausted. Stale-plus-elided control demands both notices and only current bytes.

CRLF digest controls now anchor entire output to lowercase64hex with optional LF/CRLF terminator. Final literal bracket inputs/outputs have sibling counterexamples; evidence symlink sentinel cannot leak. Final fail counter yields exit1 and successful suite explicitly exits0.
limitations: Read-only review, not a new execution claim. Existing checks-owner current-source185/0 execution evidence remains separate.
PowerShell7 ArgumentList APIs establish the harness runtime; fallback executable lookup alone does not prove WindowsPowerShell5.1 compatibility.
The finite local test child inherits suite/CI lifetime; Invoke-Prepare itself has no timeout. This receipt does not claim process deadline or arbitrary oversized-output resistance.

Some historical capability skips increment ok while printing skip; pass totals alone must not be interpreted as executed symlink or authorization controls. Digest-pattern checks and selected marker checks establish their named properties, not whole-output byte equivalence.
